about: Assist abilities per statue (docs/research/19-assists.md §5, §6): ids of the shared dtbattle_ability_data_table rows DT_AST_<kind><tier> (an assist-only statue has its own row DT_AST_<statueId>), with the client's activation conditions ([{statueType, count}] over the seat's assists; empty = always). An optional "action" holds the action-battle params of the ability (AF_* affects, lv1/lv10 slots in the units of docs/research/30-action-battle.md §7; "left" = hold categories of the lines not served) and the card name; it replaces only the inline params (and name) of assistAbilityList, never the tactical row. Built by tools/content/build_assist_abilities.py.

sources.note: assist requirement icons as conditions (Build 41), and three 'Old Mode' statue templates (oldids 3832, 3840, 3855) fetched 2026-11-21; each row cites its page and revision
research passes (local/wiki-raw/research-b33): statue pages read live 2026-11-20 and Wayback captures; the activation condition (発動条件) and HP/ATK/DEF/damage values; each row cites its page
statues without wiki assist numbers: the leaning stat at tier rarity - 2; conditions empty
assist-only statues: their own row under their own ABI_AST_<statueId>_N label, values of the kind and tier above

"action": the effect lines of the record each statue cites (else its other accepted record) parsed by tools/content/action_vocab.py (JP lines; ShoutWiki {stat, value} lines through an English table); Lv10 = Lv1 unless a line has a plausible MAX

"action".abilityName: the game's ABI_AST_<KIND><tier>_N label of the first served line's kind at the tactical row's tier (not for assist-only statues), so the card name matches its lines; affect ids AF_* are ours
